questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the cost-based optimizer in Trino?

options.text: To reduce the amount of data processed.
To select the most efficient query plan.

questions.explanation: The cost-based optimizer selects the most efficient query plan based on cost estimates.

questions.question: Which component of Trino is responsible for query planning?
questions.explanation: The Coordinator is responsible for parsing SQL queries and planning their execution.

All orders with amount greater than 100.

questions.question: Trino supports real-time data querying from multiple data sources.
questions.explanation: Trino can query data from various sources in real-time, which is one of its key features.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes federation patterns in Trino?

options.text: Running queries against a single data source.

Storing data in a central repository.
Querying data in a distributed environment.

steps.text: Select the plan with the lowest cost.
